result.rationale: In parseRefreshTokenResponse the safeParse result object ({success, data, ...}) is returned directly, not .data. In googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts the diff replaces `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` with `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)` and persists it via `data: { key }` — so the stored credential key becomes the zod SafeParse wrapper, corrupting the credential shape (and on failure data would be undefined, also triggering `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token` access on a failed parse).

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns the Zod `safeParse` result object (`{ success, data, error? }`), not the parsed `data` itself. In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code assigns `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persists it via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, which would store the wrapper object rather than the expected Google credential shape. Other usages in the diff (e.g., Office365, Salesforce) treat the return value as a SafeParse wrapper, confirming the mismatch here.
